_readme: Canonical morpheme reference for OG deck generation. APPEND-ONLY: once an entry
is verified it must never be changed - card keywords and meanings must stay
identical across the whole year so students always hear the same anchor.
Sources: Ron Yoshimoto OG materials in OG/ (scanned PDFs - render pages with
PyMuPDF and read them visually to verify), plus school decks. If a morpheme is
missing here, look it up in OG/ (Morphology.pdf, MorphologyPart2.pdf, Latin
Scrolls, Greek Combining Forms - one worksheet per morpheme with a definition
box), add it with source + verified:true, and only then use it in a deck.
ONE keyword per morpheme, forever. keyword:null = not yet set. Setting it:
morpheme NEW this week -> choose the clearest familiar derivative, lock it,
it becomes canon at first teaching. Morpheme ALREADY TAUGHT in a past week ->
the class already anchors to a keyword; ASK the teacher what was on the card,
type: root -> yellow card, prefix -> green card, suffix -> red card.
